runtime: Codex desktop subagents; fresh context per arm; one worker solves all six cases within each arm
model: Parent model inherited without overrides; exact runtime model identifier and reasoning setting were not exposed by the delegation tool
invocation: Explicit skill path; automatic discovery not evaluated
isolation: Separate fixture copies on a shared host. Workers were instructed not to access production code, network, hidden harness, sibling outputs or reference solutions; filesystem/network access was not technically sandboxed.
normalization: Task workspace and skill paths are replaced by tokens in published prompts. Build outputs and bytecode are excluded from code patches; source changes and added tests are retained.
design_note: The no-skill implementation passed all checks before the candidate skill was authored. No failure was manufactured. This release implements the approved design; these trials do not establish incremental quality improvement.
measurement_limits: Exact token use and comparable wall time were not available, so neither is reported.
Shared host, tool and base system instructions were not independently controlled.
Six cases within one arm are not six independent trials.
No automatic activation, production, framework integration, database or concurrency behavior was tested.
